Existing quality detectors can predict unreliable outputs based on internal representations with decent accuracies. semantic_scholar.summary: LLMs often answer semantically equivalent queries inconsistently, even when the underlying facts are known. We formalize consistency as semantic invariance over equivalence classes of queries and show that invariance under arbitrary meaning-preserving transformations is undecidable in general.
